name: Phenoxyethanol
aliases: 2-phenoxyethanol, 1-Hydroxy-2-phenoxyethane, 2-Hydroxyethyl phenyl ether, 2-phenoxyethan-1-ol, 2-Phenoxyethanol, 9CI, 2-Phenoxyethyl alcohol, beta-Hydroxyethyl phenyl ether, Dalpad A
summary: Phenoxyethanol is the organic compound with the formula C6H5OC2H4OH. It is a colorless oily liquid. It can be classified as a glycol ether and a phenol ether. It is a common preservative in vaccine formulations. It has a faint rose-like aroma.

uses.text: Phenoxyethanol has germicidal and germistatic properties. It is often used together with quaternary ammonium compounds. In the cosmetic industry, a common and effective synergistic strategy is to combine phenoxyethanol with ethylhexylglycerin (9:1). This pairing broadens the antimicrobial spectrum, while allowing each component to be used at lower concentrations.

summaryZh: 苯氧乙醇，是一種經常用於護膚產品的酚醚類有機化合物，可由乙二醇及苯醇醚化而成，常見於護膚霜和防曬霜。苯氧乙醇是一種無色的油狀液體，有抗菌及消毒功效，一般與季銨鹽一起使用。
summaryZhHans: 苯氧乙醇，是一种经常用于护肤产品的酚醚类有机化合物，可由乙二醇及苯醇醚化而成，常见于护肤霜和防晒霜。苯氧乙醇是一种无色的油状液体，有抗菌及消毒功效，一般与季铵盐一起使用。

pharmacology.en: It is not a psychoactive drug. It kills bacteria by disrupting their cell membranes, which is why it is used as a preservative.
pharmacology.zh: 它不是精神作用藥物。它透過破壞細菌的細胞膜來殺菌，因此被用作防腐劑。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它不是精神作用药物。它通过破坏细菌的细胞膜来杀菌，因此被用作防腐剂。

sideEffects.en: On the skin it can cause irritation and allergic reactions. Swallowed in quantity it depresses the nervous system and can damage the liver and kidneys, and it has caused serious harm to infants when applied heavily.
sideEffects.zh: 接觸皮膚可能造成刺激與過敏反應。大量吞食會抑制神經系統，並可能損傷肝臟與腎臟；大量塗抹於嬰兒身上曾造成嚴重傷害。
sideEffects.zhHans: 接触皮肤可能造成刺激与过敏反应。大量吞食会抑制神经系统，并可能损伤肝脏与肾脏；大量涂抹于婴儿身上曾造成严重伤害。

fact.en: It is one of the most common preservatives in cosmetics and vaccines, and is also used as a fixative in perfume and as an anaesthetic for fish.
fact.zh: 它是化妝品與疫苗中最常見的防腐劑之一，也用作香水的定香劑，以及魚類的麻醉劑。
fact.zhHans: 它是化妆品与疫苗中最常见的防腐剂之一，也用作香水的定香剂，以及鱼类的麻醉剂。
